responsibility: This file adapts GCC’s linemap and diagnostic subsystems for the Modula-2 frontend. It manages file/line entry and exit in the line_table, constructs location_t values for columns, ranges, and binary expressions, extracts file/line/column information from locations, and wraps GCC error, warning, note, and internal-error reporting with formatting support that understands GCC quote/color conventions, making it the frontend’s source-location and diagnostic bridge.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the m2linemap group: it performs the real linemap manipulation and diagnostic formatting/reporting work against GCC internals, whereas m2linemap.h only declares that bridge for C/C++ and m2linemap.def exposes it to Modula-2.
